create_app_state_end_session: create an AppStateEndSession instance to terminate a HITL session and upload collected data to S3
get_next_state_transition: get the next app state by checking elapsed time and connected user count to decide session reset
update_simulation_camera_view: update the simulation with a top-down camera view and broadcast the transform to all connected clients
finalize_and_upload_session_data: finalize the session by saving episode outputs as JSON gzip files and uploading them to S3
review_session_end_delay: review the SESSION_END_DELAY constant that controls how long users see the end message before being disconnected
